verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results. Tasks keep running after a call returns: they can be resumed and polled by thread_id, emit progress notifications, and pause for approval of sensitive actions or for more information, which supports reviewing the work. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that background tasks complete reliably, and documentation of a dedicated review or notification experience outside the MCP polling flow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
The task may still be running. Keep the `thread_id` and call `call_perplexity_computer` again with that same `thread_id`
The Computer MCP server sends status updates as MCP progress notifications while a task runs.
Approves or denies a sensitive action like sending an email or deploying code.
